title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Handling of Appeal Cases Involving Firearms and Explosives
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issues Concerning the Handling of Appeals in Cases Involving Guns and Explosives

Fa [2003] No. 8

The High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

After our court issued the "Notice on Issues Concerning the Implementation of the 'Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Trial of Criminal Cases Involving the Illegal Manufacture, Sale, Transport, Guns, Ammunition, and Explosives'" (hereinafter referred to as the "Notice") on September 17, 2001, some High People's Courts have inquired to our court as to whether, in cases where the requirements of the Notice are met but a final judgment has already been rendered in accordance with the "Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Trial of Criminal Cases Involving the Illegal Manufacture, Sale, Transport, Guns, Ammunition, and Explosives" (hereinafter referred to as the "Interpretation") promulgated by our court on May 16, 2001, and the parties have filed an appeal, the people's court may retry and modify the judgment in accordance with the spirit of the Notice. For the purpose of accurately applying the law and judicial interpretations, notice is hereby given on the relevant issues as follows:

Where, after the promulgation of the Interpretation, a people's court has tried and rendered a final judgment in a criminal case involving the illegal manufacture, sale, transport, guns, ammunition, or explosives, and a party has filed an appeal in accordance with the law, if upon review it is determined that the final judgment does not conform to the provisions of the Notice, the people's court may, based on the specific circumstances of the case, retry the case in accordance with the trial supervision procedure, and modify the judgment in accordance with the spirit of the Notice.

January 15, 2003
